summary: Important: podman security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The podman tool manages pods, container images, and containers. It is part of the libpod library, which is for applications that use container pods. Container pods is a concept in Kubernetes.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: Denial of Service via crafted AES-GCM packet decoder inputs (CVE-2026-46597)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * When using `--mount` in `podman run` results can be inconsistent, especially on /var/tmp (JIRA:RHEL-154348)
  * [RFE] SELinux confined users unable to start podman.socket systemd user service (JIRA:RHEL-132875)
  * [RFE] Mounting of NFS Quadlet volume fails with permission denied (JIRA:RHEL-145863)
  * [RFE] podman API socket to support TLS/mTLS (JIRA:RHEL-91221)
  * Rebase podman to the latest upstream release [rhel-9.9] (JIRA:RHEL-168737)
  * podman does not clean up all files and leaves orphaned files consuming disk space [rhel-9.9] (JIRA:RHEL-173976)
  * [FJ9.8 Bug]: [REG]The "podman-remote save" command fails for rootless users. (JIRA:RHEL-186006)
  * podman: rebase to 5.8.5 (JIRA:RHEL-212537)
  * [FJ9.9 Bug]: [REG]The "podman rm" command can accidentally delete containers even though it is mounted by Buildah when used by a rootless user in remote. (JIRA:RHEL-211092)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.  

Additional Changes:  

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the AlmaLinux 9 Release Notes linked from the References section.
